title: Curiosity about heroin
summary: He overcame his fear out of curiosity, with friends doing it around him.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: How do you get involved in heroin? How are you introduced to heroin?
I, for one, am terrified of a
What do you do about that?

Well, I overcame the fear at one point just to find out what the hell it was that they were talking about. I wanted to see what it was. A bunch of the people I was associating with were into it, doing it, saying nothing negative about them.
Was there a feeling that this was a possible bummer or was there a feeling that this was going to be kind of okay and a good fling?
I didn't know, but I was willing to take a chance. I was curious enough to get into it, to try it once.
Was it curiosity or was it some sort of--as we know now in all of our sophistication--a statement, a negative thing? Was it going to be fun or were you saying the hell with mother, or whatever?
I don't know, Bill; I think it was more pure curiosity; to try to analyze it beyond that point --
